title: REPLICATING HUMAN SOCIAL PERCEPTION IN GENERATIVE AI: EVALUATING THE VALENCE-DOMINANCE MODEL

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting multimodal generative AI models to rate facial images on a 7-point scale across 13 psychological traits, and using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to determine if the models replicate the human valence-dominance model of social perception (trustworthiness and dominance).

Comparing the AI-extracted facial trait dimensions against human judgment data collected from 11 different world regions using Tucker's coefficient of congruence to evaluate cross-cultural alignment and regional variance.
